verdict.rationale: DGX B200 docs show strong headless-operation building blocks — CLI tools like nvidia-smi, Docker Engine/NVIDIA Container Toolkit for containerized workloads, and remote management via Redfish/IPMI/SNMP — all of which support running the system without a GUI and integrating into automated pipelines. However, there is no explicit mention of CI/CD integration, scripting examples, or automation-specific tooling (e.g., APIs for job orchestration in CI systems). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs, automation API examples, and independent confirmation of headless CI usage in production.
